label: windows-installed
scope: Actual Windows Google Chrome with isolated temporary context. Browser DPR emulation is not actual Windows 125/150% system scaling. Installed 0.1.21 service, headless actual Chrome. No OS scaling was changed by this matrix. Functional assertions do not certify every pixel or all-page accessibility.

installedService.scope: Installed service metadata read locally; authentication token intentionally excluded. Process/executable provenance is verified by the parent Windows upgrade report.

screenshotRetention: 22 raw screenshots and actual browser recordings retained in ignored local cache; 14 representative public screenshots copied alongside this report. Public Iris, public-domain H&E and explicitly synthetic discovery example only.

flag.description: Header saved-status text appears close to or overlapping Appearance icon at narrow project-identity width; reported to maintainer for geometry confirmation. Not covered by the functional matrix assertions.

contrastScope.scope: Visible UI text sampling in two themes at 1280 DPR1 across six states; excluded scientific artwork/disabled/unscorable backgrounds. Not a full AA certification. Initial source failures remain separately archived.
